reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: This daily facial moisturizing ampoule is an absolute game-changer for dehydrated, dull skin. From the moment you press it into your skin, it delivers an immediate burst of deep, concentrated hydration that instantly plumps and wakes up your complexion. The lightweight, fast-absorbing formula sinks in effortlessly without leaving any sticky or heavy residue, leaving your face feeling intensely nourished, silky-smooth, and visibly glowing. Perfect for layering under your daily moisturizer or makeup for all-day moisture retention and a healthy barrier. Highly recommended for an effortless daily radiance boost!
reviews.zh: 呢款每日面部保濕安瓶，對於缺水、暗啞嘅皮膚嚟講，絕對係改變遊戲規則嘅產品。由你壓落皮膚嗰一刻開始，佢就即刻帶嚟一陣深層、高濃度嘅水分，即時令膚色飽滿、提亮。質地輕盈、吸收快，好容易就吸收晒，唔會留低任何黏膩或者厚重嘅殘留物，令面部感覺深層滋養、絲滑順滑，同埋睇落好有光澤。好啱喺每日保濕霜或者化妝之前疊喺底層，令全日都保持水分、皮膚屏障健康。非常推薦，輕鬆就可以提升日常嘅光彩！

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text:
お試しで一つ購入してみました！
手のひらで混ぜるの面倒そうかと思いきや、すぐに溶けるので全然大丈夫でした♪
香りはなく、ねっとりした美容液なのに浸透は早くて「これはスペシャルケアでもっと持っておきたい！」と思いました。リピ決定です♪
おまけのサンプルはミニボトル系が入ってるのかと楽しみでしたが数種類のパウチセットでした(笑)
reviews.zh:
試買咗一盒！本來以為用手掌攪拌會好麻煩，但係好快就溶晒，完全冇問題 ♪
冇香味，質地係濃稠嘅美容精華，但係吸收好快。我覺得「呢款係 Special Care，想多啲囤住！」，決定會回購 ♪
原本好期待贈品會係迷你樽嘅，但係結果係幾款袋裝小樣嘅套裝 (笑)

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: I tried the Hyaluronic first and enjoyed it, so I knew I had to try other varieties. I like both the Hyaluronic and this Cica one. Will definetely try the other three soon.
reviews.zh: 我先試咗 Hyaluronic 版本，好鍾意，所以就知道一定要試吓其他款式。我兩款 Hyaluronic 同呢款 Cica 都好鍾意。好快就會試埋其他三款。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text:
Very soothing. Hydrate and stabilise my skin. Absorbs quickly and does not leave any sticky or greasy feelings on the skin.
The capsule dissolves quite fast when the essence is added.
reviews.zh:
非常舒緩。補水同穩定我嘅皮膚。吸收好快，搽完唔會黏，亦唔會油膩。
加入精華之後，膠囊溶解得幾快。

reviews.text: I have no words to explain the amount of i love i have for these wellage one day kit i have seen an amazing results and thats why i am stocking them up by far the best product of my life that i used and has impressed me love them
reviews.zh: 我真係講唔出有幾鍾意呢啲 Wellage one day kit。我見到好驚人嘅效果，所以而家大量囤貨。係我用過最好嘅產品，令我印象深刻，我好鍾意。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: Very soothing and hydrating formula. I love all of Wellage's products and this one is really good for those who want intensive moisture and soothing, feels like you've used a sheet mask - will definitely stock up!
reviews.zh: 配方非常舒緩又補水。我好鍾意 Wellage 嘅所有產品，呢款真係好啱想要深層保濕同舒緩嘅人，搽落好似用咗面膜咁——一定會大量囤貨！

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: Esta mascarilla es increíble para las pieles sensibles, disminuye muchísimo la irritación y las Roges en la piel, por lo que se la recomiendo a todas las personas que sufren de rosácea
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜對敏感肌膚好好，大大減少咗皮膚嘅刺激同泛紅，所以我會推薦畀所有患有玫瑰痤瘡（rosacea）嘅人。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Cica Calming One Day Kit (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: Moisturising serum contains 2 parts you need to mix together and apply to your face. I have combi skin and for me it was too oily IDK
reviews.zh: 呢款保濕精華要分成兩部分，要攪勻之後先搽喺面上。我嘅皮膚係混合性，對我嚟講就太油咗，我都唔知點講。
